subject: Monitoring Alliance: Integration charter + commercial handoff
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@datadog.com>, Marco Russo <marco@grafana.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Monitoring Alliance: integration charter + kickoff

Hi Alyssa & Marco,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together a lightweight charter to scope a first-phase integration between Datadog, Grafana, and Redwood Inference:

- Goal: ship a supported integration that routes model-serving telemetry (latency, token throughput, model variant traces) into Datadog and Grafana dashboards with minimal infra changes for customers.
- MVP: OTLP exporter + example dashboards, documented installation for Redwood Dedicated and Private, and a joint co-sell one-pager.
- Success metrics: three reference customers onboarded and <10% increase in per-request latency attributable to instrumentation.

I'm attaching a quick spec and an MAP draft. Can you confirm if the technical assumptions match what your teams expect (esp. sampling strategy and metric naming)? If that looks good, let's lock a 60-minute technical kickoff next week and include a commercial touchpoint after the first technical sprint.

Attachments: RDW-Integration-Spec-v1.pdf (pdf), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
phone: +1-415-555-0198

---

From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@datadog.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Russo <marco@grafana.com>, Nina Patel <nina@observantlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 13:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Monitoring Alliance: integration charter + kickoff

Diego — thanks for the doc and the clear scope. Quick notes from Datadog's side: 

- Sampling: we prefer server-side adaptive sampling for heavy-token traces (we can supply an agent rule).
- Metric naming: recommend prefix "redwood.inference" and tag with model_name, deployment_tier, region.
- Security: customers will expect TLS + mTLS options for exporter connections for Dedicated/Private.

We can commit an SE and an engineering lead to the kickoff. Proposed times: Tue 11/9 10:00 PT or Wed 11/10 14:00 PT.

Alyssa Cheng
Partner Manager, Datadog
alyssa@datadog.com

Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:41:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Monitoring Alliance: integration charter + kickoff

Hi all — appreciate the outline. Two points from Grafana's engineering team:

1) OTLP pipeline: Grafana Cloud will accept OTLP over HTTP/GRPC, we can provide an official exporter example that attaches trace/span attributes so dashboards work out-of-the-box.
2) Dashboards: we'd like to co-maintain a Grafana dashboard repo; propose a set of panels for latency percentiles, token-rate heatmaps, and alert templates.

I'll bring a solutions engineer to the kickoff. If helpful, we can also share a short reference implementation repo ahead of the meeting.

Best,
Marco Russo
Partner Solutions, Grafana Labs
marco@grafana.com
